capabilities: Start and stop timers on checkbox tasks
Show a live timer in the status bar
Review sessions by day, week or custom range
Filter history by client and project
Export sessions as generic, Toggl or Clockify CSV
extras: Full documentation is hosted on a separate site; more export formats (Harvest, Everhour) are planned; importing entries into Clockify requires a paid plan or trial on Clockify's side.
motivation: The author built it for personal use because they could not find a plugin that did what they wanted.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track time on tasks, and existing timers do not combine checkbox-based tracking with export to outside tools.

relations.evidence: compatible with the Tasks plugin format, with no external services involved at any point
Plays nicely with Dataview, but never depends on it
Toggl-formatted CSV — matches the exact columns expected by Toggl's official importer
Clockify-formatted CSV — matches the exact columns expected by Clockify's Timesheets importer

summary: Local-first timer that tracks time on checkbox tasks and exports sessions as CSV for Toggl or Clockify importers.
